name: codex-astra-iso-ordinal-r1
final_message:
Created `tests/test_agent.py` using only pytest and the standard library. Library code is unchanged.

Ran the requested command: **165 passed, 4 xfailed**.

The four strict expected failures document an existing ordinal-date parsing bug: dates are shifted forward by one day.
